research_question: Does structural MRI add predictive value beyond clinical and cognitive data when predicting Alzheimer's disease progression and development?

dataset.split: fixed subject-level train/val/test, no individual crosses splits

outcomes.progression: Increased Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) at the next available visit
outcomes.development: Development of Alzheimer's disease within three years among individuals beginning at CDR 0

whole_volume.model: r2plus1d_18 3D CNN embeddings + clinical/cognitive LightGBM fusion
whole_volume.provenance_caveat: full_model_auc, image_only_auc, and mri_masked_auc below are inherited from the original project's production Stage-4 model, whose image block combined whole-volume MRI AND PET embeddings together -- not an MRI-only model. This repository's own whole-volume pipeline (src/training/train_wholevolume_cnn.py, src/evaluation/wholevolume_fusion_ablation.py) is MRI-only and has not been re-run to regenerate these numbers. See results/whole_volume/mri_pet_production_fusion.json and results/README.md for full detail, including a lower-rigor (single-seed, untuned) genuinely MRI-only alternative.

hippocampal_roi.model: 64x64x64-voxel hippocampal ROI, 3D ResNet-18-style CNN embeddings + clinical/cognitive LightGBM fusion

multiregion_roi.model: Hippocampal + entorhinal cortex + amygdala + ventricular ROI CNN embeddings + clinical/cognitive LightGBM fusion
multiregion_roi.provenance_caveat: full_model_auc, mri_masked_auc, and mri_contribution_delta below are retained from previous publication. During this audit, the exact source file implementing the scan-eligible-subset-at-seed-202 methodology (matching the hippocampal ROI approach) could not be located. The only located multi-region result file (results/multiregion_roi/fusion_multiseed_full_test_population.json) uses the full test population and reports different fused-model values (progression 0.7550, development 0.8027) -- a known, unresolved discrepancy. image_only_auc values ARE verified against that file.

interpretation: Clinical and cognitive variables provided a strong baseline.
Whole-volume MRI added negligible independent predictive value.
Anatomy-focused MRI recovered a stronger imaging signal.
The largest MRI contribution was the hippocampal development result of +0.0536 AUC.
The highest overall AUC was the multi-region development result of 0.8602.
Overall fused performance and the unique contribution of MRI are not the same concept.
